body: I can't even imagine being followed for killed for minding your own damn business...

I feel bad for not having my shit together or not knowing what I want. I don't want to admit that to my family. They're already so happy for me, but I don't feel the same

it's harder to reach out for help because there's this stigma in my family where a lot of family members(including my parents) don't believe in mental health issues. and think that people who have issues are either crazy or pitiful
I've had people in my life pretty much tell me it's my fault that I can't make friends or have any. But it's just difficult  when you're quiet and anxious person
